why: A published control id can never be renamed or removed. It becomes a Patch Bay port id and a binding key, and both are written inside saved projects: taking one away cuts the cables of every project that used it, in silence. Specification 3.2.
rule: This file is a RECORD, not a copy. It is written by hand when a control ships, and it is worth nothing the day it is generated from the profiles it guards. npm run check compares the two and refuses a profile that has lost an id, or gained one nobody recorded.
silent: A silent control -- hold, oct-down, oct-up, display -- has no port and no binding key today, so nothing in a saved project names it yet. It is recorded all the same: the day one of them turns out to send something after all, it stops being silent and its id becomes a port id, and an id that was drawn on screen for a year is one people have already learned.
